cards.t: Cysic Suspends Bridge After Unauthorized Mint
cards.b: Cysic suspended its crypto bridge after an unauthorized mint of 10 million CYS tokens. The attacker bridged about $727,000 in proceeds to Ethereum through Mayan, deBridge, and SWFT's Bridgers.

per.CYS: Bridge suspended after unauthorized mint of 10 million tokens.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full remediation timeline and fund recovery status

cards.t: Qubic Network Freezes Chain After Exploit
cards.b: Qubic froze its chain after an attacker drained 1,400 wallets using weak seeds. Network validators are currently preparing to vote on a recovery plan while 87.1% of stolen funds remain onchain.

per.QUBIC: Qubic network frozen following exploit draining 1,400 wallets.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact recovery plan details and validator vote timing
